Container.Name: LuckyTwitchMiner
Container.Overview: Twitch Channel Points Miner. The run.py script is included in the image and updated with each image update. Configure environment variables below.

Config.Name: Streamer list folder
Config.Description: Any Unraid folder you like (e.g. a share you can open easily). Put a file named streamers.txt in it. Restart the container after editing the file.

Config.Name: Mining priority
Config.Description: Comma-separated priorities, highest first. Choices: STREAK, DROPS, SUBSCRIBED, ORDER, POINTS_ASCENDING, POINTS_DESCEDING. Keep ORDER last to fill remaining slots. Apply changes to restart the container.

Config.Name: Telegram chat ID
Config.Description: Optional. Set together with the Telegram bot token, or leave both empty. Group chat IDs are negative and must keep the leading minus (e.g. -123456789).

Config.Name: Telegram bot token
Config.Description: Optional. Set together with the Telegram chat ID, or leave both empty.

Config.Name: Telegram pinned badge drops
Config.Description: Optional. Claimed badge/emote drops are pinned in Telegram; this many newest pins are kept (0 disables pinning). The bot must be an admin with the 'Pin messages' right.

Config.Name: Discord webhook URL
Config.Description: Optional. Leave empty to disable Discord notifications.

Config.Name: Require linked account for drops
Config.Description: Optional. Set to true if you only want to farm drops for campaigns with a connected game account. When false (default), drops are farmed regardless of whether an account is linked.
